column_lineage.transformation: DATEDIFF(YEAR, CAST(c.date_of_birth AS DATETIME2), CAST(CAST('2025-06-30' AS DATE) AS DATETIME2))

summary: This job populates the `stg.customers` table from `dbo.customers`, stripping out PII names, standardizing county text, and calculating age as of a fixed actuarial reporting date ('2025-06-30') for downstream reporting.
risk_notes: T-SQL `DATEDIFF(YEAR, c.date_of_birth, @asof)` counts calendar year boundaries crossed rather than actual elapsed years (e.g., 2024-12-31 to 2025-01-01 equals 1 year); a standard PySpark `datediff` divided by 365 or `months_between` will produce different results unless explicitly handled as `year(asof) - year(date_of_birth)`.
Hardcoded T-SQL variable `@asof = '2025-06-30'` will cause static/stale calculations in PySpark unless converted into a dynamic pipeline parameter or job configuration.

T-SQL `SELECT INTO` implicitly creates table schemas dynamically; migrating to PySpark requires explicit Delta Lake schema definitions to avoid unexpected type coercion or schema drift on `mode('overwrite')`.
